verdicts.proof: Old res_payment_details_tab.dart:151 shows the green box only when paymentStatus=='paid' && status!='cancelled'. The only v2 entry point is the v2 detail 'card' segment (res_detail_view_v2.dart:108-111), which renders the same ResPaymentDetailsTab; that branches at res_payment_details_tab.dart:90 to ResPaymentDetailsV2, where res_payment_details_v2.dart:91 uses the identical condition, with a tick icon and the same 'paymentProcessed' text (:100-104).

The filter lives in the shared paymentDetailsProvider (res_payment_details_tab.dart:49-52: status != draft/cancelled), which runs before the v2 branch. v2 lists the same d.invoices with the same InvoiceTile (res_payment_details_v2.dart:106-111). paymentDetailsProvider and ResPaymentDetailsV2 are used nowhere else (grep). The filtering is silent in both looks, as before.

Old res_payment_details_tab.dart:122-126 shows the row when d.n('card_rounding') != 0, labelled pdMinCardLine or pdWaiveLine. v2 res_payment_details_v2.dart:53 and :58-59 use the same condition, labels and sign.

Old res_payment_details_tab.dart:53-55 swallows a failed invoice fetch, and :72 uses async.valueOrNull with no error branch. That same build method feeds v2 (d and loading are passed in at :92 and :101). v2 draws the spinner only while loading (res_payment_details_v2.dart:84-90) and has no error state. The behaviour is identical and silent in both looks.

The old copy rows (_CopyRow, :134-141, tap at :262-266) show a copy icon and a toast. v2 marks the same five rows copy:true under the same conditions (res_payment_details_v2.dart:65-70). _CopyRowV2 (:196-201) copies to the clipboard and shows an MgToast, and :215 draws a copy icon.

The calculation runs once in the shared state at res_cancel_dialog.dart:28-29 (StornoCalc.effectiveRefundPercent/Amount, which includes capAfterMove; reservation_models.dart:449-502), before the MgV2 branch at :40. v2 receives the same pct and refund (:46-48). res_cancel_v2.dart:42-46 colours the box green/amber/red by the same pct==100/50 thresholds, :62 shows the 'stornoConditions' heading, :66-67 shows three rule lines (cs: 7 a víc dní 100 %, 2–7 dní 50 %, méně než 2 dny bez vrácení), and :69 shows the refund line with the same amount and percent, in bold and coloured. Entry points: in v2 the only way to cancel is the detail tab. ResDetailV2View (res_detail_view_v2.dart:97-106) renders the same ResDetailTabContent, whose cancel button is at res_detail_tab_content.dart:338-349, shown only when st==nadchazejici; it calls _showCancelDialog (reservation_detail_screen.dart:169, :302-309) and opens ResCancelDialog. The v2 list card (reservations_screen_v2.dart:145-152, res_card_actions_v2.dart:115-138) has no cancel action, so the old list _CancelDialog cannot be reached in v2. That is one entry point fewer, not a bypass. The server recomputes the refund in cancel_booking_tracked.

Old dialog: title 'cancelReservationQ', with 'Zpět' and a red 'Zrušit rezervaci' button (res_cancel_dialog.dart:61, :100-109). v2 (res_cancel_v2.dart:47-48, :84-87) uses an MgDialogFrame with the same title, a safe button 'Nechat rezervaci' (onKeep = Navigator.pop, res_cancel_dialog.dart:51) and an MgBtnDestructive 'cancelReservationBtn' that is the only path to _doCancel (:52). Nothing is sent without that tap.

The released 4.1.3 file (git show 70a94933) had no PopScope, and its 'Zpět' button stayed enabled; only the cancel button was disabled while loading. The branch adds PopScope(canPop:!_loading) and disables both buttons in the old look (res_cancel_dialog.dart:58-59, :101, :105). The v2 branch is wrapped in the same PopScope(canPop:!_loading) (:41-42), which blocks system back and barrier taps (both go through maybePop on the dialog route). res_cancel_v2.dart:84 sets onKeep to null and :85 sets onCancel to null with busy:loading (spinner) while _loading, and :76 also disables the reason field. A retry from the result dialog goes back through _doCancel, which sets _loading=true and _result=null (:116-119), so the locked confirm view is shown again. The server also answers a second call with 'already' (cancel_booking_tracked).

Old: an optional TextField with the hint cancelReasonHint (:89-96), and _doCancel substitutes 'customerCancelled' when the field is empty (:120-121). v2: the TextField hint is the same cancelReasonHint (res_cancel_v2.dart:75-82), and onReason writes the same _reason (res_cancel_dialog.dart:50). The same _doCancel supplies the default.

The result is chosen in the shared state before the v2 branch (res_cancel_dialog.dart:32-37) through cancelResultDialog. That function has its own v2 branches: cancel_result_dialog.dart:39-45 for success / 'already' and :65-73 for failure. They use the same texts and the same retry rule (canRetry :63-64), shown with a tick or cross disc and a heading (res_cancel_v2.dart:116-128), plus a support row on failure. On close, the same .then in reservation_detail_screen.dart:305-308 invalidates reservationsProvider and reservationByIdProvider. Note: in the released 4.1.3 the dialog simply popped and an error appeared only as a snackbar (git show 70a94933). The in-dialog result is new on this branch and present in both looks.

The released 4.1.3 has no gear handling at all: reservation_models.dart has neither isGearOnly nor bookingKind (git show 70a94933), so the only guard is on the server. STATE_5:21 lists the RESTRICTIVE policy bookings_gear_customer_select (booking_kind<>'gear' OR is_admin() OR _gear_customer_visible()); STATE_5:22 and STATE_4:25 list the admin-only insert/update/delete policies and trg_zz_gear_booking_guard. Both looks read the same reservationsProvider query (reservation_provider.dart:10-11, the _bookingSelect '*, motorcycles!moto_id(...)', with no client filter), so visibility is decided by the server in both. Grep finds no gear RPC (create_web_gear_booking, customer_update_gear_*, get_my_gear_bookings) anywhere in lib, and no v2 file references isGearOnly, so v2 cannot create or reveal gear bookings. The v2_where cited in the chunk (res_sections_v2.dart:57) does not exist. What the edit screen does with a gear booking once app_visible is switched on is out of scope here: it is the same model in both looks and is protected by the server RPC-only writes.

Rule: _calendarStatus returns dokoncene when today is after endDate (reservation_models.dart:413). It is unchanged since 70a94933 (the diff touches only comments around displayStatus :380-393). In v2 every entry point uses the same displayStatus. Detail: ResDetailV2View renders the same ResDetailTabContent, where edit and cancel appear only when st==nadchazejici (res_detail_tab_content.dart:338). List card: res_card_actions_v2.dart:118-138 switches on the same status, and dokoncene offers only rideDetail and rateBtn, with no edit and no SOS. Home (home_state.dart:97,117, home_screen_v2.dart:92) and the shell FAB (app_shell_v2.dart:176) also read displayStatus. The global SOS follows sosAllowed (status=='active'), as in the old look (home_reservations_section.dart:108 vs home_bookings_v2.dart:63). The behaviour is identical, and silent in both looks. Remaining gap in both looks, not a v2 regression: an overdue customer still on the road sees 'Dokončené' without explanation.
